note: Three sites off Summit Road, the forest road along the top of Sideling Hill, spread over 0.8 mile and each set 150 to 200 ft back from the road. Summit Road C is an open grass-and-gravel clearing about 40 m across, reached by a gravel track that drops about 4.5 m from the road (about 7%). Summit Road B is a smaller clearing the agency calls somewhat secluded. Summit Road A is a small grass pull-in in sight of the road, listed at 30 ft and described as holding one vehicle with tents. Grass at A and B is soft after rain. Summit Road leaves State Route 4006 off North Valley Road, north of US 30 at Harrisonville; the sites are about 1.8, 2.3 and 2.6 miles along it. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
